overrides.replacement_claim: Sprint summary, TUI, performance status API, and workbench projections omit durable lifecycle and cancellation state because their aggregate path bypasses durable-run enrichment.
overrides.reason: Both theories identify the same projection defect. The aggregate summary uses the raw performance projection, and the API, TUI, and HTML consume that summary.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence endpoint has a compatibility path that returns an unversioned ad hoc artifact payload instead of the schema-versioned PerformanceEvidenceResult DTO.
overrides.reason: The optional evidence capability permits a fallback response lacking the documented versioned evidence-result shape.

overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance configuration table documents hard maxima above the built-in defaults even though validation rejects every value above its built-in default, causing documented supported values to fail configuration loading.
overrides.reason: The documented hard maxima exceed defaults for multiple settings, while validation uses defaults as ceilings.

overrides.replacement_claim: PerformanceResult returns an unclassified raw error when no terminal result exists, bypassing performance-specific transport error mapping.
overrides.reason: The unavailable-result branch returns a plain error, while performance-specific HTTP mapping recognizes only typed performance use-case errors.

overrides.replacement_claim: The shared operation runner may silently discard invalid performance configuration, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether validated Effective values make the path reachable.
overrides.reason: The runner discards performanceSettings errors, but the requested executable test produced a failure-signature mismatch and therefore did not show whether normal composition can reach the runner with settings that fail that helper.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance CLI collapses every classified non-cancellation performance failure into the validation exit class, so distinct operational failures lose appropriate CLI exit behavior.
overrides.reason: Cancellation is handled separately, but every other performance error is unconditionally wrapped with ExitValidation.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance failure path may publish flow state after its verification writer token becomes stale because no immediate fence check is shown before SaveFlowState.
overrides.reason: The static sequence exposes a check-to-publication interval, but no requested executable evidence was obtained because the original session was unavailable.

overrides.replacement_claim: ValidateRepairReverification accepts persisted performance reverification records with malformed nested target results because it validates only top-level performance fields.
overrides.reason: TargetResults are persisted, but their target identities, qualifications, comparisons, and outcomes are not validated.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance-output parser accepts malformed trailing content after an otherwise valid envelope because it does not require the second decode to return EOF.
overrides.reason: Only a successful second decode is rejected; malformed trailing syntax yields an error that is treated as acceptable.

overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance evidence response intentionally exposes bounded metadata references, including paths and digests, while withholding artifact contents and raw output.
overrides.reason: The supplied documentation permits bounded evidence references and metadata. No supplied criterion categorically forbids public path or digest metadata.

overrides.replacement_claim: The TUI exposes mutating performance actions for a disabled project when a historical performance attempt exists.
overrides.reason: An existing attempt satisfies the navigation gate independently of policy enablement and exposes start, resume, cancel, and recover.

overrides.replacement_claim: Policy validation may falsely treat a fenced or commented pseudo Performance Targets heading as a declaration, but the required executable evidence is unavailable.
overrides.reason: Parsing excludes pseudo-sections and validation uses a separate declaration helper, but no requested executable evidence was obtained because the original session was unavailable.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance manifest discovery accepts descriptor markers separated from a function declaration by blank lines or additional comments despite requiring immediate precedence.
overrides.reason: The discovery loop retains a pending marker while skipping blank and comment lines before accepting a later function.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance-specific defaults and lower-only policy validation are implemented in the generic platform config package instead of the owning product module.
overrides.reason: The platform package defines performance-domain defaults and lower-only workflow policy despite the domain-neutral platform criterion.

issues.claim: Documented performance hard maxima cannot be configured because runtime validation rejects values above defaults.
issues.title: Documented performance maxima are rejected
issues.reason: The public supported ranges conflict with the validator's lower-only default ceilings.

issues.claim: Requesting a performance result before one exists returns an unclassified raw error and bypasses performance-specific transport mapping.
issues.title: Unavailable result loses error classification
issues.reason: The raw unavailable-result error is not converted to the typed error recognized by the web boundary.

issues.claim: Generic platform configuration code owns performance-specific defaults and lower-only policy validation.
issues.title: Performance policy is embedded in platform config
issues.reason: Product defaults and bounded-context validation reside in a package required to remain domain-neutral.

issues.claim: Aggregate performance projections bypass durable-run enrichment, leaving operational lifecycle and cancellation state empty across status API, workbench, and TUI surfaces.
issues.title: Performance surfaces omit durable lifecycle state
issues.reason: Presentation adapters consume the raw aggregate projection instead of the enriched status use case.

issues.claim: Historical attempts cause disabled projects to expose mutating TUI performance actions.
issues.title: Disabled projects expose performance mutations
issues.reason: An existing attempt exposes start, resume, cancel, and recover independently of current policy enablement.

issues.claim: Malformed trailing JSON after a valid performance envelope is accepted.
issues.title: Performance parser accepts malformed trailing data
issues.reason: The parser rejects a second valid value but fails to require EOF.

issues.claim: All non-cancellation performance CLI failures are reported with the validation exit class.
issues.title: Performance CLI collapses operational exit classes
issues.reason: Distinct configuration, runtime, timeout, dependency, and persistence failures cannot retain appropriate CLI exit behavior.

issues.claim: Descriptor markers need not immediately precede their functions because discovery skips intervening blank and comment lines.
issues.title: Discovery weakens marker adjacency rule
issues.reason: Pending marker state survives lines that should invalidate immediate adjacency.

issues.claim: Persisted repair performance reverification accepts malformed nested target results.
issues.title: Repair reverification omits nested target validation
issues.reason: Top-level authority is validated, but nested target identities, qualifications, comparisons, and outcomes are not.

issues.claim: A supported evidence endpoint branch returns an ad hoc unversioned payload rather than PerformanceEvidenceResult.
issues.title: Evidence fallback violates versioned response contract
issues.reason: Adapters lacking the optional evidence capability receive an incompatible successful response without a schema version.

evidence_requests.gap: The prior executable reproducer produced a failure-signature mismatch and did not determine whether the discarded helper error is reachable through normal composition.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Ask the original investigator to strengthen an executable Go _test.go reproducer in its approved private workspace so it constructs the shared operation runner through normal production composition with an Effective value for which performanceSettings demonstrably returns an error.
evidence_requests.required_observation: Show whether the runner still executes an operation or whether composition rejects the same configuration before runner invocation.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Assert performanceSettings fails for the exact Effective value used, exercise the production composition path, and verify no operation side effect occurs before any expected rejection.

evidence_requests.gap: No executable evidence was produced for markdownHeadingPresent handling of pseudo-headings.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Ask the original investigator to create an executable Go _test.go reproducer in its approved private workspace that calls ValidateRequirementsContentWithPolicy with disabled policy and otherwise-valid requirements containing Performance Targets headings only inside fenced, commented, quoted, and indented pseudo-sections.
evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert whether a policy-mismatch finding is emitted for each pseudo-section while ParsePerformanceTargets returns no targets.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include a real unquoted Performance Targets heading as a positive control that must produce the disabled-policy mismatch.

evidence_requests.gap: No executable evidence was produced to test the fence-check interval.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Ask the original investigator to create an executable Go _test.go reproducer in its approved private workspace that deterministically advances the verification fencing generation after PublishState and before SaveFlowState.
evidence_requests.required_observation: Observe whether flow state changes under the stale token and distinguish rejection from successful stale publication.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Use deterministic hooks rather than timing and compare immutable performance-state and flow-state bytes before and after the generation change.
